title: Loop Disabled due to constraints
symptom: Getting RED warning icon in overview. Loop displays on the 'Last run' field: LOOP DISABLED BY CONSTRAIMTS BgQualityCheck: Doubled values in BGSource. AAPS is configured to ignore BG values from NS, with only xDrip as BG source, but loop is disabled due to doubled values.
cause: The issue is likely caused by the new BG Quality Check plugin introduced in commit 2b021ffafc0c4f01df65b7dfe28c3d0e51cc088f, which detects doubled values in BGSource.
fix: Update to latest dev and clear database.
evidence_quote: you may try update to latest dev and clear db
